title: Input to the subatlas-consistency subagent
description: Everything the consistency step needs, passed in rather than derived: the orchestrator owns the project layout, the subagent owns the judgement.

cell_label.description: The atlas's own label for the cell set.

labelset.description: Disambiguates a label reused across labelsets.

contributors_path.description: Path to subatlas_contributors.json for this cell set (from `python -m atlas_chat.cli_contributors`). The cutoff has already been applied; do not re-derive it.

cas_path.description: Path to the project's CAS+ document, read for the atlas's own markers, synonyms and composition — the material for working_definition.

project_dir.description: Project directory, for the local snippet index and supplement store of contributing papers.

name_resolution_path.description: Optional name_resolution.json, when resolve-name has already run: its resolved_names sharpen the comparison.

output_path.description: Where to write subatlas_consistency.json. Put it beside subatlas_contributors.json so the validator hook can cross-check purity against it.
